dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Who's that "old friend", if I may ask?

dialogues.speaker: Frith
dialogues.text: Hehe... I suppose you could call her a friend.

dialogues.speaker: Frith
dialogues.text: It was a long time ago. Back then, I was still young, doing some... less-than-honorable business in Nod-Krai. I was the leader of a group of desperate souls, you might say.

dialogues.speaker: Frith
dialogues.text: We had a good run for a few years, until I crossed paths with a Treasure Hoarder named Katya.

dialogues.speaker: Frith
dialogues.text: She was about my age, claiming to "put an end to my evil deeds" out of nothing but hot-blooded passion... She beat me seven or eight times, but never once took my life.

dialogues.speaker: Frith
dialogues.text: She told me that living outside the law couldn't last forever. If I stayed on this path, sooner or later, someone would take my life... if not her, then someone else.

dialogues.speaker: Frith
dialogues.text: She was right. So... I gave all my wealth to the kids in the Conch Gang and set out for an adventure at sea.

dialogues.speaker: Frith
dialogues.text: The rest of the story is nothing to speak of. I wonder if that woman is even still alive...

dialogues.speaker: Frith
dialogues.text: Heh, that perfume of yours certainly brought back memories of her.
